data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $15.9m (2018: $110.0m). Specialty lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $40.4m and $16.1m respectively. Both the specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases from 2018. Political, accident and contingency provided releases of $12.3m. These releases were offset by strengthening in marine of $6.7m and property of $16.1m. US trucking being the main driver of the marine division's increase, while construction and engineering drove the strengthening in property. The syndicate has since stopped underwriting both of these lines of business. Reinsurance saw reserves strengthen by $30.1m, driven by loss creep on Typhoon Jebi and the Woolsey Fires.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a small prior-year release of reserves in 2019 totalling $15.9m (2018: $110.0m). Releases were concentrated in specialty lines and cyber & executive risk, partially offset by reserve strengthenings in marine and property and by a material strengthening in the reinsurance book driven by loss creep on prior catastrophe events (notably Typhoon Jebi and the Woolsey Fires). Overall the prior year movement was a modest favourable development relative to opening gross claims outstanding.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (insurance-liabilities) was not presented explicitly in the movement notes. The report explicitly states a prior year release of $15.9m in the Managing Agent narrative (used here). That narrative figure appears to be a net release as reported in the text; no explicit gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure was found in the detailed movement tables. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 50) but the detailed development-period cumulative rows were not unambiguously extracted for a robust triangle-based PYD calculation, so the narrative net release was used. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD millions).

_claims_triangle.notes: A Gross claims development table is present on page 50 (gross ultimate by underwriting year and development % rows). The detailed development-period cumulative amount rows were not unambiguously parsed for automated diagonal comparison, therefore the development_rows array is left empty and the triangle is referenced for manual review.
